label: RB951Ui-2HnD
description: MikroTik RB951Ui-2HnD (RB951Ui-2HnD) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR9344.
notes: Inlet is eth1, outlet eth5. https://mikrotik.com/product/RB951Ui-2HnD (read 2026-11-28): Number of DC inputs 2 (DC jack, PoE-IN), DC jack 8-30 V, Max power consumption 24 W, Max power consumption without attachments 7 W, PoE in Passive PoE 8-30 V, PoE-out ports Ether5, PoE out Passive PoE, Low voltage PoE-Out current limit 500 mA, Max total out 500 mA. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/rb951-series/: "The device accepts power from the power jack or from the first Ethernet port (Passive PoE). The power consumption for RB951G-2HnD under maximum load can reach 7 W, RB951Ui-2HnD 24 W." The 24 W ceiling includes the USB load and whatever eth5 passes through, so the inlet asks for the 7 W the board itself draws; eth2-eth4 are poeIn: false; eth5 sources power it did not generate, so its budget stays unknown.
